targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TIMESTAMP(date_day) AS time,
  CONCAT(country, ' | precip_mm') AS metric,
  CAST(SUM(total_precipitation_mm) AS FLOAT64) AS value
FROM `event_fusion.fct_daily_weather_sports`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(date_day))
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT
  TIMESTAMP(date_day) AS time,
  CONCAT(country, ' | goals') AS metric,
  CAST(SUM(total_goals) AS FLOAT64) AS value
FROM `event_fusion.fct_daily_weather_sports`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(date_day))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT
  country,
  league_name,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_temperature_c), 2) AS avg_temp_c,
  ROUND(AVG(total_precipitation_mm), 2) AS avg_precip_mm,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_goals_per_match), 2) AS avg_goals_per_match,
  ROUND(AVG(goals_per_precip_mm), 3) AS avg_goals_per_precip_mm
FROM `event_fusion.fct_daily_weather_sports`
WHERE has_weather_data = TRUE
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY avg_goals_per_precip_mm DESC

panels.title: Weather vs Goal Rate by League

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_day,
  country,
  league_name,
  total_goals,
  matches_count,
  ROUND(avg_temperature_c, 2) AS avg_temperature_c,
  ROUND(total_precipitation_mm, 2) AS total_precipitation_mm,
  ROUND(goals_per_precip_mm, 3) AS goals_per_precip_mm
FROM `event_fusion.fct_daily_weather_sports`
ORDER BY date_day DESC, country, league_name
